suggestions.title: Suggested alignment revision (needs faculty review)
suggestions.before: Evaluate the societal and environmental impacts of DSP technologies, ensuring responsible innovation in engineering solutions.
suggestions.after: Design and implement digital signal processing solutions that filter, transform and analyze real-world signals while considering their environmental, economic and societal impact on communities.
suggestions.why: Kept the apply/create focus on practical DSP solutions for CLO 3 but added consideration of environmental, economic and societal impact so it builds PO 8 and contributes to the Socially Responsive Steward attribute.

suggestions.title: Suggested alignment revision
